# NexSync Labs

> NexSync Labs is a software studio based in Rampurhat, Birbhum, West Bengal, India. The studio builds ERP software, customised ERP systems, dynamic websites, SEO-optimised websites, invoice management systems, iOS and Android apps, food delivery apps, astrology apps and school management software.

Contact: hello@nexsynclabs.com | +91 98765 43210
Address: Rampurhat, Birbhum, West Bengal 731224, India
Hours: Monday to Saturday, 10 am to 7 pm IST
Website: https://nexsynclabs.vercel.app

## Services

- [ERP Software](https://nexsynclabs.vercel.app/services/erp-software): Inventory, purchase, sales, accounts and reporting for mills, cold storages and distributors.
- [Customised ERP Systems](https://nexsynclabs.vercel.app/services/custom-erp): Bespoke ERP modules for non-standard workflows, multi-branch operations and integrations.
- [Dynamic Websites](https://nexsynclabs.vercel.app/services/dynamic-website): Content-managed business websites with admin panels, catalogues and enquiry management.
- [SEO-Optimised Websites](https://nexsynclabs.vercel.app/services/seo-websites): Fast, crawlable, schema-rich websites built for local search.
- [Invoice Management System](https://nexsynclabs.vercel.app/services/invoice-management): GST billing, ledgers, payment tracking and monthly reports.
- [iOS & Android Apps](https://nexsynclabs.vercel.app/services/mobile-apps): Cross-platform mobile apps for customers, staff and internal operations.
- [Food Delivery Apps](https://nexsynclabs.vercel.app/services/food-delivery-app): Customer app, delivery partner app and restaurant dashboard for local food businesses.
- [Astrology Apps](https://nexsynclabs.vercel.app/services/astrology-app): Kundli, horoscope, consultation and subscription features with Bengali and English interfaces.
- [School Management Software](https://nexsynclabs.vercel.app/services/school-management): Admissions, attendance, fees, exams and parent communication.

## Service areas

NexSync Labs has one studio in Rampurhat. The following are service areas where the studio works and aims to rank for local searches — not branch offices.

Birbhum: Rampurhat, Tarapith, Nalhati, Sainthia, Suri, Dubrajpur, Bolpur, Santiniketan.
Jharkhand border: Pakur, Dumka, Jamtara.
Further in West Bengal: Malda, Berhampore, Durgapur, Asansol.

Service-area pages: https://nexsynclabs.vercel.app/service-areas
